name: Grafana Cloud MCP server
summary: Grafana Labs' hosted MCP server for Grafana Cloud: external AI agents connect at mcp.grafana.com/mcp over Streamable HTTP and, after an OAuth 2.1 browser authorization scoped to the signed-in user, query metrics, logs, traces and profiles, read and write dashboards, alerts and incidents, and start Assistant investigations. Measured keyless on 2026-10-05: initialize, an empty POST and a GET each answered 401 with a bearer challenge; the discovery documents behind it are public and name three scopes. Part of Grafana Assistant for billing; a Grafana Cloud account is required.
license: Hosted under the Terms; OSS server source Apache-2.0

agentAccess.notes: Keyless 2026-10-05: initialize, empty POST and GET all 401 with a bearer challenge; discovery public (endpoint is its own issuer, PKCE S256, scopes grafana:read/query/write, DCR). Docs: Grafana Cloud account, Assistant enabled, terms accepted, Editor role or cloud-mcp permission, browser sign-in.

payments.notes: Read 2026-10-05: no keyless request drew a 402; no vendor page read names a machine-payment protocol. Pricing page: Free plan '3 active AI users per month', Pro 'self-serve', '$19 per month' platform fee then 'pay as you go'. No page read names the payment method, so humanBilling is unknown.

jobs.summary: The vendor's words: Assistant 'helps you investigate incidents'; investigations 'explore metrics, logs, traces, and profiles, build hypotheses, and produce a report'; the Cloud MCP server lets agents 'query metrics, logs' and start investigations (create_investigation). Not measured: 401 keyless.
